inputs_sent.prompt: A locked-off wide shot of a bedroom at night. The camera does not move. A man lies asleep in the bed and does not move. A glowing copy of the same man, with a thin bright rim of mint-green light and a fine shimmer, slowly sits up out of his sleeping body, partly see-through at first. He swings his legs to the floor, stands up at the foot of the bed, becoming more solid, and turns to look down at the sleeper with a kind half-smile. The sleeper stays still under the duvet. Only two figures: one solid and asleep, one glowing. Slow, deliberate motion. One continuous shot, no cuts, no music, no speech, no subtitles.
